semantic_description: Run the pinned Cloudflare security-audit methodology as an explicit, source-only Glasswing/Core build and release assurance capability.
responsibilities: Validate pinned methodology provenance and audit inputs.
Validate the seven required source-only audit artifacts.
Run the pinned coverage and findings validators.
Fail closed on incomplete evidence or forbidden execution boundaries.
non_responsibilities: Enabling Forge, runtime, consumers, OpenSandbox or production paths.
Executing target-controlled code or authorizing remediation or deployment.

informative.summary: Explicit build/release assurance over an immutable source snapshot; never a pre-commit or production control.
